import json, sys, random, cProfile, pstats, io
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
rng = random.Random(3)
toks = ['t%d' % i for i in range(24)]
atoms=[]; seen=set()
while len(atoms) < 8:
    p = tuple(rng.choice(toks) for _ in range(16))
    if p not in seen: seen.add(p); atoms.append(p)
req = {'services': toks,
       'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'and', 'args': [{'op': 'contains', 'path': list(p)} for p in atoms]}}],
       'queries': [[toks[j % 24] for j in range(4096)] for _ in range(4)]}
line = json.dumps(req).encode()
pr = cProfile.Profile(); pr.enable(); out = m.process(line); pr.disable()
s = io.StringIO(); pstats.Stats(pr, stream=s).sort_stats('tottime').print_stats(10)
print(s.getvalue()[:1800])
EOF
